content:
Three people were taken to the hospital Thursday after a two-vehicle crash in central Laredo left a truck flipped onto its side, according to KGNS.

The crash happened at the intersection of Meadow Avenue and Lane Street. Two men from the overturned truck were taken to Laredo Medical Center with injuries that were not specified in the report, and a 66-year-old woman from the second vehicle was taken to Doctors Hospital in stable condition. A fourth person refused treatment at the scene, according to KGNS.

Police shut down the intersection for cleanup and urged drivers to use alternate routes while crews worked the scene.

No cause for the crash was reported, and no official was quoted in the report.

Sources: KGNS.

title: Three Hospitalized After Truck Flips Onto Its Side in Central Laredo Crash
